scope: FMA native metadata and independently precomputed acoustic feature source recovery; no historical reference or NC source inputs
checks: Verify official metadata/license custody, CRC/hash binding, selected archive members, and exclusion of EchoNest, pickle and audio payloads.
Reconcile raw API snapshot track rows (109727) and cleaned metadata/feature rows (106574), report exact intersection, excluded rows and missing labels/features without denominator conflation.
Treat FMA genre IDs as native track observations; prohibit artist genre facts or MusicBrainz identities without exact bridges.
Audit artist ID resolution, missing primary artists, aliases/name-only links, multi-performer limits, and album grouping availability.
Audit duplicate track IDs, exact acoustic duplicate rows, shared album/performer IDs and source split conflicts; distinguish enforceable grouping from unresolved entity leakage.
Verify split/fold salts and model settings frozen before metric inspection; require training-only normalization, vocabulary, priors and prototype construction.
Compare fixed acoustic methods to training-only popularity and appropriate permuted-feature or no-acoustic controls; do not tune against test results.
Keep rare, unseen, missing-label, missing-feature, unresolved-artist and cold groups visible; report abstention and complete eligible/total denominators.
Independently recompute saved predictions/metrics and validate source role and artifact hashes; source-positive recovery is distinct from semantic precision and independent musical judgment.

Inspect portable/new acoustic stage boundary: CC0 core remains separate from attributed CC-BY FMA packs and optional NC style calibration; no default or public promotion is inferred from source recovery.
regression_policy: Add focused tests for concrete bugs only; coordinate changes to agent-owned implementations.
prespecified_limitations: Source artist IDs are not complete performer-credit identities.
Missing artist or album metadata cannot prove performer/album isolation.
Identical metadata/acoustic rows may not identify all recording duplicates.
Source taxonomy recovery does not validate artist genres or Every Noise semantic parity.
This audit does not acquire or listen to audio.
